The '''Kes system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was situated on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] between the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan system/Legends|Alsakan systems]], and during the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] between the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], it was the site of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Mine/Legends|minefields]]. In [[16,921 BBY]], the [[Battle of Kes]], one of the rare direct confrontations between the two worlds' forces during the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Conflicts]], was fought in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==Description==
The Kes system was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]],<ref name="EGTW" /> which served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]], specifically its [[Arrowhead]] portion.<ref name="Regions" /> The Perlemian Trade Route linked the Kes [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Alsakan system/Legends|Alsakan system]] and<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> known as [[Belgoth's Beacon]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
Around [[17,000 BBY]], the Kes system fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] was fought&mdash;the first of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the Republic between its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of that conflict, the stretch of the Perlemian Trade Route traversing through the Kes system connected the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]] and Alsakan systems. As such, it featured [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Mine/Legends|minefields]], and in [[16,921 BBY]], the system was the site of the [[Battle of Kes]], the only direct confrontation during the early Alsakan Conflicts between the forces of the two belligerent systems. The battle resulted in a tactical draw.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kes system was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
